actions.subject: RE: Order VT-23410 confirmation
actions.body:
Priya,

Kev's just opened the delivery for VT-23410 and they're 15mm again. All six of them. The lockshields are fine, the TRVs are wrong.

That's three times now. September, November and today, same mistake every time. In November you told me my account was flagged so picking would be double checked. Whatever that was, it hasn't worked.

I've got a customer on Thursday who has taken a day off for this job and I can't fit 15mm valves to 22mm pipe. So I need six of the 22mm angled TRVs here by Wednesday at the latest, not a promise of early next week. If you can't get them out by then tell me today and I'll go to the merchants and you can credit the lot.

Send someone to collect the wrong ones, I'm not driving them back to you on my time.

And honestly, after three goes I'm looking at other suppliers. I've been with you a long time and I don't want to, but I can't keep ringing customers to move jobs.

Dave

actions.subject: RE: Thursday
actions.body:
Hi Grace,

Yes, still planning on Thursday the 18th, but I want to be straight with you. The valves for your radiators came this morning and the supplier has sent the wrong size again, so I'm chasing them for the right ones.

I've told them they need to be with me by Wednesday. If they are, Thursday goes ahead as planned and you won't notice a thing. If they're not, I'll pick some up from the merchants myself so we can still do it.

I'll text you Wednesday evening either way so you're not left guessing on the day you've taken off.

Sorry for the faff, it's not on your end at all.

Cheers,
Dave
